prose: Tonight's stream will be a rare treat, with the first time on-screen meeting of Archeo-Astronomer John McHugh and sacred geometry mystery seeker Jason Quitt. These two authors have both made incredible discoveries about the ancient world and the astrotheological systems implicit in mythology & religious artifacts. You'll never look at the scripture in the stars the same way after this episode!
